source_note: 社区 Wiki 原网页与 2026-09-13 本轮实测逐字交叉核对；带 raw 的记录已在游戏内出现。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Hey, %1$s. I found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 嘿,%1$s。我在家里发现了一张一直落灰的蓝图,觉得你可能会感兴趣。

messages.text: Here you go! Hopefully, you'll make better use of it than I ever could.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 给你! 希望你能比我更好地利用它。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Hey, I noticed you haven't used that blueprint I gave to you. Did you lose it?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 嘿,我发现你还没用我给你的那张蓝图。你把它弄丢了吗?

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Luckily for you, I made a copy!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 算你走运,我还留了副本!

messages.text: Here you go! Don't misplace it this time. It would've done just the same in my home.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 给你! 这次别再弄丢了。它放在我家也只会继续吃灰。

messages.text: No worries, I'll hang on to it for now. I'll come back later.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 没事,我暂时替你留着。我之后再来。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was complex.
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实测逐字核对；社区 Wiki 原网页语境一致。
messages.zh: 嘿,温室建得怎么样了? 那张蓝图可够复杂的。
messages.raw: Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was complex.

messages.text: Thank you! I'll be checking in to see how you're doing with the Greenhouse.
messages.gloss: 2026-09-13 实测逐字核对；社区 Wiki 原网页语境一致。
messages.zh: 谢谢! 我还会来看看你的温室建得怎么样。
messages.raw: Thank you! I'll be checking in to see how you're doing with the Greenhouse.

messages.text: No worries, I'll come back later.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
